Form 20-F ☒ Form 40-F ☐ On November 2, 2026, Enlivex Ltd., a company organized under the laws of the State of Israel (“ Enlivex ” or the “ Company ”), issued a press release announcing 12-month topline data from the randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase IIa stage of the Company’s multi-country Phase I/IIa trial (ENX-CL-05-001) evaluating Allocetra™ in patients with moderate to severe knee osteoarthritis.

The information contained in the four bullets immediately under the heading “Summary of the 12-month Topline Data, Age Group 64+” in the press release is hereby incorporated by reference into the Company’s registration statements on Forms S-8, F-3 and F-3MEF (File No. 333-256799 , File No. 333-232413 , File No. 333-232009 , File No. 333-252926 , File No. 333-286956 , File No. 333-292417 , File No. 333-294284 , File No. 333-295215 and File No. 333-298071 ), filed with the SEC.
